source.title: Hush Money
source.description: I can't afford the reputation loss or the financial loss you and your goblin friend are causing me. So here's the deal, I'm gonna give you inside information on how Gnomish Engineer's get stuff done. In exchange, make yourself scarce! I don't want to see you around here anymore!
source.objective: Accept the Bribe from Fizzbizz Coppercoil
source.completion: This is all you're getting right now! Come back a week from now and I'll have more for you.
